Will and Will Not

During the Season of Resolutions™ I have noticed two major camps

  1. I will NOT......look at porn....gain weight

  2. I WILL...lose weight...

And it is interesting to analyze the psychology of those two frames of mind on a subjective level to discover which is a proper mindset to have.

I remember Scott Adams mentioning that using "not" as a form of persuasion fails every time because people aren't primed to respond to negatives. For example when Biden says "I'm not a pedophile" we instinctively negative the not in our mind and simply see

I'm a pedophile.

I don't know if this is true nor exactly how it works in our brains. However, a simple way to frame our goals and resolutions into simple terms is positive rhetoric and negative rhetoric.

When we say, I will not drink booze I will not look at porn that is a negative perspective because subconsciously we cancel out the not's and hyper focus on the object of goals. So in the above example subconsciously we see

I will booze

I will look at porn

So, going forward i'm going to restructure my resolution and my goals into a positive frame:

I will respect my physical and mental health every day because that's what my future self would want. I will seek a fullfilling diet and seek knowledge that is wholesome because i'm wholesome and I deserve that.

Booze and porn and soy burgers and [insert example] are fear controls that seek to bring us down mentally, physically and emotionally. It's best to just get rid of them from our language entirely and substitute a good habit instead.

This is only relevant to the people from VCDL and other groups who plan to enter the buildings and lobby, but I suspect it was what the cop was talkng about.
